name: mnemonic_void_echo_cannon
label: Echo of the Unremembered
poeticVision: The player wields the very emptiness of their past. Each shot is a desperate act, launching a phantom limb of a forgotten self to lash out at the hunters. The satisfaction of a successful strike is immediate, but so too is the chilling sensation of a deeper void opening within Lyra, a brief, disorienting glimpse into the growing chasm of her identity. It’s a power born of loss, making every victory a step further into the unknown, a weapon that leaves you more hollow even as it saves your life.

parameters.name: speed
parameters.description: The movement speed of the Void Echo projectile.

parameters.name: damage
parameters.description: The amount of damage the projectile deals on impact.

parameters.name: lifetime
parameters.description: The duration in seconds before the projectile automatically despawns if it doesn't hit anything.

dependencies: Player.gd (or equivalent player script with 'fire_void_echo' and '_on_player_identity_tremor' methods)
Enemy.gd (or equivalent enemy script with 'take_damage' and 'apply_void_impact_effect' methods)
A CanvasLayer with a ColorRect for player screen effects.
verdict: A weapon born of absence, it carves survival from the very essence of self-loss, turning every desperate strike into a chilling echo of what Lyra once was.
impact: This mechanic introduces a profound layer of emotional and strategic depth. Players will constantly weigh the immediate need for survival against the gradual erosion of Lyra's identity, making every successful attack a bittersweet victory. It transforms resource management into a narrative device, forcing players to confront the core theme of self-loss with every trigger pull, creating a unique and unforgettable internal conflict.
